name: Xbox 360 Racing Wheel v1
notes: 110-byte descriptor. Source: DJm00n/ControllersInfo xusb_wheel1. 16-bit wheel + 8-bit accelerator + 8-bit brake (Sim Page) + 10 buttons + hat. Routes through hidmaestro_xusb.inf XUSB companion (matches xbox-360-wired path). No xinputhid driver mode (would force 16-button gamepad layout, breaking subtype fidelity). The XInput subtype is 0x02 and the HID product string Wheel (XBOX 360 For Windows), the name Windows' xusb22 gives the HID device of a pad of that subtype (measured with xusb22 10.0.28000.3365). On the USB/IP backend xusb22 lays the wheel out as xbox-360-wheel-v2's descriptor does, X and Z at 16 bits. xusb22 gives this profile's layout, Z and a Simulation accelerator at 8 bits, only when its Parameters key, which holds for the whole machine, has WheelPedalUsage 0xBB32 (measured with xusb22 10.0.28000.3365). No byte of the device selects it, so this profile and xbox-360-wheel-v2 present the same USB device, and no public source tells the two wheels apart.
